szoveg_eredeti:
Trusted AI starts with the people who build it.

 Qai , in collaboration with Hugging Face , is hosting the Qai × Hugging Face Hackathon in Doha from 5–7 November 2026.

Bringing together developers, engineers and students, the event will provide an opportunity to collaborate, build practical AI solutions and present working projects to a panel of judges.

Through this initiative, Qai aims to support the development of AI talent in Qatar, encourage hands-on innovation and strengthen the capabilities needed to turn AI technologies into real-world applications.

Applications close on 29 October. Places are limited and participation is subject to selection.

Apply: https://lnkd.in/eZ5MgRY7
